title: English Conversation 7:  How are your Kids?
content: 1. to be doing well: to be succeeding, progressing nicely, or living well - Is your brother doing well? - Our company is doing well these days. 2. college: an institution of higher learning like a university - Did you go to college? - My son will go to college next year. 3. to grow up: to get bigger and develop (only for living things); to spend one's childhood - The kids are growing up fast. - She grew up in California.
